_note: Landing subsystem (GER) local numbers, owner D5, revision D5-R4 (CR-A1-34, D-30; C5-R3 cartridges CR-C5-10 revised). Read by fusion/landing.py (ctx.local) and team/D5/feet_calc.py (P:landing.*). Shared numbers (fin TE x, half-fin height 0.21, board, foot height 0.048, CG, loads) come from params/params.json and are not repeated here. Frame: params.json#frame (x aft, y right, z up, metres). Each foot is a telescoping crush unit in the fin plane: a bonded PETG shoe seated on a 9.3 mm step cut in the half-fin TE tip (the shoe wraps the board and both edge-strip ends, CR-C4-09), a PETG piston (one tine, two snap fingers, stop flange) with a neoprene pad, and an XPS crush cartridge from the piston floor to the shoe back wall. Stack along +x (down in hover): back wall, cartridge, piston floor/flange, pad; the flange stops on the sleeve-end rim after stroke_max_m. Upper feet (UR, UL) take solid type-U cartridges, lower feet (LR, LL) bored type-L cartridges; every cartridge segment is pre-crushed 1 mm on a press (C5-R3: plateau upper 39.4 N, lower 35.6 N, bias x1.05 / x0.95, CR-C5-10 revised).

section_y_m.note: R4: 17.3 x 13.3 mm (was 16 x 13.3) so the solid type U gives C5-R3's 39.4 N upper plateau at 172 kPa; the z depth stays 13.3 mm so the fin step stays 9.5 mm (CR-D5-11)

section_z_m.note: type U area 230.1 mm2 -> 39.6 N at 172 kPa (C5-R3 39.4 N); the tuning knob after T-D5-COUPON (y only, so the step depth does not move)

bore_lower_d_m.note: R4: 7/32 in (5.56 mm) axial bore cut by a sharpened K&S 7/32 in brass tube (was 1/4 in): type L 205.8 mm2 -> 35.4 N (C5-R3 35.6 N), bias x1.056 vs C5's x1.05; same outside, so one piston and one shoe for all four feet

segments.note: two 44.5 mm pieces cut across a 2 in F-250 board so the crush axis is the through-thickness axis of the board (the datasheet direction)

clear_m.note: per side, cartridge in the piston bore

preload_m.note: cartridge cut 0.5 mm long so the hooks seat on the window aft edge without play

colour_upper.value: orange PETG piston + orange paint stripe on the cartridge (type U, solid)

colour_lower.value: blue PETG piston + blue paint stripe on the cartridge (type L, bored)

precrush_m.note: each of the two segments is cut 1 mm long and pressed 1 mm on the drill press before assembly: removes the ~1.10 first-yield peak of BOTH segments (in series an un-pressed second segment would peak mid-stroke when the first densifies); the pressed length is the CAD length

wall_t_m.note: two 0.4 mm perimeters, 100 % solid; shoe sleeve and piston tine

slide_clear_m.note: per side, tine in sleeve (PETG on PETG); check with the first print

leg_depth_m.note: R4: 10 -> 7 mm to pay for the wider R4 cartridge (-1.2 g on four shoes); legs bonded to both fin faces below the step; bond RF stays >= 1.4 (CL-D5-BOND-SF)

glue_gap_m.note: per side between shoe and fin (epoxy line)

window_z_m.note: snap-finger window height in the two y walls of the sleeve

rim_t_m.note: extra wall (three more perimeters) round the sleeve end: bearing lip for the side load at the pad, and the end-of-stroke stop

rim_len_m.note: must start aft of the fin TE

collar_len_m.note: two collar cheeks forward of the step front over both edge-strip ends (the strips end at the square-tip front, D3)

lip_m.note: the flange and pad reach this far beyond the sleeve roof (sleeve roof at z_outer - lip), so the rim stays inside the pad edge

w_m.note: copied, D3 owns it: CF 10 x 1 mm on both faces along the half-fin top edge; ends at the step front, wrapped by the collar

flange_t_m.note: floor and stop flange; the R3 overhang beyond the tine is only 2 mm

engage_m.note: tine engagement in the sleeve before any crush; grows to engage + stroke

hook_protrusion_m.note: hook through the 0.8 mm sleeve wall

finger_len_m.note: free finger length >= 6.0 mm (CL-C6-SNAP-L-MIN); 6.5 mm gives 1.7 % strain

finger_w_m.note: finger width between the two slots

slot_w_m.note: two 0.8 mm slots in each tine y wall make the finger

window_rail_m.note: rail left each side of the inspection window in the tine z walls (colour check, lighter tine)

replace_mark_m.note: R4: 6 -> 3 mm. Groove on the tine 3 mm aft of the rim: once it is inside the sleeve, less than C5's pair-first stroke (31.5 mm) plus the 3 mm guard is left; replace the insert (CL-D5-MARK-MARGIN)

z_outer_m.note: outboard edge of the pad and flange (D-30, kept with the 0.21 m half-fins); tip-over pivot = z_outer - edge_r

edge_r_m.note: edge round on the flange and pad

stroke_max_m.note: flange-to-rim gap (D-30); the wing TE stays 10 mm off the ground at full stroke

span_m.note: spanwise length of the TPU corner cap on the fixed wingtip; inboard edge 1.5 mm outboard of the outboard elevon end (k9.elevon_spans: 0.560)

chord_m.note: chordwise depth of the cap legs forward of the TE

tape_g.note: two wraps of 12 mm filament tape over the cap legs

glue_g_per_foot.note: epoxy on the shoe (0.35) + foam-safe CA on the cartridge (0.05)
